evidence:
Paths named by the brief all exist and are staged. instruction.md:3 names '/instructions' ('the six notes') and '/assets/seed_data.json'; environment/instructions holds exactly six files (behaviour.md, integration.md, overview.md, policy.md, security.md, ui.md) and environment/assets holds seed_data.json. environment/Dockerfile:14-16 has 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/' and 'RUN chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets', byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile. Cross-references between notes resolve: policy.md:3 'as described in ui.md' and integration.md:5 'the boundary in security.md' both name shipped files. task.toml:2 'artifacts = ["/app", "/assets"]' matches staged-task-contract.md:38, and test.sh:88 only chmods /assets.

Content matches what each party assumes. seed_data.json parses as JSON: {"snippets": [], "note": "No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. Build a JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history."}. instruction.md:3 says it 'describes the starting scope; there is no starter app to finish' and integration.md:7 says it 'describes the starting scope and contains no user snippets or starter implementation'; both are true of the file. The solution makes no use of it: no reference to seed_data or /instructions in server.js, src/* or the built bundle; the only '/assets/' strings in the solution are the URL paths of its own bundle in public/index.html, not the filesystem asset. solve.sh:38 removes app.db before copying, and app.tsx:159 renders 'No saved snippets yet', so the golden starts with the empty library the seed describes. No judge criterion or prompt references /assets, /instructions or seed content, and app_context.md:23 tells the judge 'Do not assume an empty library', so no criterion depends on seed contents either way. The preview runner asset is shipped twice (public/runner.html and static/runner.html) with identical bytes.

Counterexamples tried. Broken app that could pass because of the asset: none, since nothing graded can be satisfied by copying the seed (it holds no snippets and no probe values). Conforming alternative that could fail: an app that ignores the seed, or one that imports its empty snippets list, starts in the same state as the golden; an app that preloads its own sample snippet is also unaffected because of app_context.md:23.

Run evidence and its limit. The scripted golden results on these bytes (editor, runtime, polish, persist-before, persist-after all true, pageErrors empty) show the app works from an empty database in the agent image, which is consistent with the seed, but no script reads /assets or /instructions, so the in-image presence of those paths is established from the Dockerfile source, not from a measurement. The hosted run is on an earlier candidate and is not used as evidence for these bytes. The private check-assets-referenced.py and check-fixtures.py were applied by hand, not executed.

Note, not a defect: the seed carries no data, so it is a scope statement rather than an input; the brief describes it accurately as such.
